the ISS distribution of liver tissue can be estimated using wavelet transforms, and that the ISS distribution is a useful signature to distinguish healthy and diseased liver tissue.

1. the wavelet modulus maxima can be used to extract the locations of regular scatterers in ultrasound images; 2. the wavelet transform can be used to estimate the inter-scatterer spacing (ISS) distribution from ultrasound images of liver; and 3. the wavelet-based ISS estimation technique can be used to detect diffuse and focal diseases such as cirrhosis and cancer in the liver.
